scope: 58 vertices partitioned into a fixed induced C28 and a fixed C30 plus six freely chosen pairwise disjoint noncycle chords. All 840 cross edges and all 405 possible right chords are variables. Left cross degree is six; right cross degree plus chord degree is six. All actual pairs have distance at most two. No J+P normalization, fixed chord endpoints or pairings, or additional symmetry constraints. This construction family is not all 58-vertex graphs.
